title: Foundation: content + user domain models, pack manifest schema, tuning file
accept: All §5 content models exist as immutable Dart types with exactly the pinned fields: PhonicsSkill(id, name, sequenceOrder); Level(id, ordinal, newSkills, format: sentence|multiSentence|paragraph, vocabEnabled, narrationEnabled); Story(id, levelId, title, pages, riveAnimationRef, celebrationAudioRef, collectibleRef, skillsExercised, packId, contentVersion); Page(sentences); Sentence(words, narrationAudioRef?); WordToken(text, graphemePhonemeMap: [(graphemes, phonemeId)], pronunciationAudioRef, vocabCardId?); VocabCard(id, word, definitionText, definitionAudioRef, illustrationRef?); Phoneme(id from the 44 English phonemes, humanAudioRef); Collectible(id, storyId, riveRef, sceneSlot); TongueTwister(id, levelId, words, targetPhonemeId, narrationAudioRef, packId); GraphemeSound(id, grapheme, phonemeIds ordered, introducedAtLevelId, exampleWords: [(wordText, pronunciationAudioRef, minLevelId)]); StoryPack(id, version, minAppVersion, manifest of stories+twisters+assets, checksum).

All §5 device-local user models exist as Dart types: Profile(localId, displayName, ageBand: 5-6|7-8|9-10, currentLevelId, micConsent, cloudAsrConsent, createdAt); StoryProgress(profileId, storyId, status: locked|available|completed, completedAt?, timesRead); WordHelpRecord(profileId, wordText, encounterCount, helpCount, lastHelpLevel: none|soundOut|modeled); TwisterProgress(profileId, twisterId, timesCompleted); CollectionState(profileId, earnedCollectibles).
Pack manifest JSON round-trips: a fixture StoryPack manifest serializes to JSON and deserializes to an equal object; every content model above is representable in the manifest.

Manifest schema validation rejects a manifest missing a required field with a per-field error naming the field and the offending story/twister id (negative tests per field: e.g. Story without riveAnimationRef, Sentence at a sentence-format level without narrationAudioRef when Level.narrationEnabled, TongueTwister without targetPhonemeId or narrationAudioRef).
Sentence-format story invariant is enforced by validation: sentence-format stories have exactly one page with one sentence (negative test).
narrationEnabled default rule is encoded: true at all sentence-format levels (a sentence-format Level with narrationEnabled=false fails validation); higher levels default false and may opt in.
Audio refs are source-agnostic opaque strings (no type distinction between recorded and future TTS) — asserted by API shape.

lib/domain/tuning.dart exists and is the single tuning file containing exactly the pinned constants with pinned defaults: struggleT1 = 4s, tier2WaitT2 = 4s, word-mode phonetic closeness thresholds (max 1 substituted phoneme for words of <= 4 phonemes, max 2 for longer), struggle sensitivity per A-12 (two consecutive finalized non-matching speech hypothesis bursts, or sustained silence >= T1 — both tunable), and the separate sound-mode (twister/Sound Garden) threshold set per A-13 (accept when >= 60% of the target phoneme sequence matched with per-phoneme distance <= 1, target-phoneme instances weighted double — tunable); a test asserts the pinned default values.

AgeBand exposes the three pinned bands and nothing else; word count bounds for A-8 (sentence levels 3-8 words, paragraph 40-90 words across 1-3 pages) exist as named constants for the linter to consume.
pinned_design: Transcribe §5 verbatim as Dart types. Content models are authored and immutable once published; user models are device-local only (no server holds user data). WordToken.graphemePhonemeMap is an ordered list of (graphemes string, phonemeId) pairs and drives sound-out highlighting — digraphs are one entry ('sh' maps as one unit). vocabCardId presence on a WordToken means it renders blue when Level.vocabEnabled. Sentence.narrationAudioRef is required at sentence-format levels (A-11), supplied by the product owner. Phoneme.id is one of the 44 English phonemes. StoryPack is a versioned bundle: JSON manifest per §5 + Rive + audio assets, checksummed, with minAppVersion. Profile max 4 per device (the constant lives here; enforcement is local-storage/UI). Level.format moves sentence → multiSentence → paragraph; vocabEnabled turns on blue vocab at the first paragraph level; narrationEnabled true at all sentence-format levels, opt-in above. GraphemeSound (Unit 15/§5): id, grapheme ('oi', 'sh'), phonemeIds ordered (plays via the recorded phoneme set), introducedAtLevelId (drives awake/muted in the Sound Garden), exampleWords as (wordText, pronunciationAudioRef, minLevelId) tuples — a word appears on the card only when profile level >= minLevelId; full inventory ships in binary starter content, example words extend via packs (manifest must represent GraphemeSound inventory + example-word extensions). Tuning file (Unit 6): 'Timings T1/T2, struggle sensitivity, and phonetic-closeness thresholds (Unit 4) are constants in one tuning file; pilot adjustments touch only that file.' Pinned values: T1 = 4s, T2 = 4s; word-mode closeness: at most 1 substituted phoneme for words <= 4 phonemes, at most 2 for longer; struggle semantics per A-12; sound-mode defaults per A-13 (>= 60% of target phoneme sequence matched at per-phoneme distance <= 1, target phoneme weighted double). No JSON for user models is needed beyond what Drift/analytics tickets do themselves.
notes: Foundation ticket: nearly every other ticket depends on it — build first. Pure Dart, no Flutter imports, fully headless-testable. Do not add Drift annotations here (local-storage owns persistence). Formerly-open tuning values are now pinned: struggle semantics A-12, sound-mode thresholds A-13 (OD-1/OD-2 resolved). The 44 phoneme ids: use a standard ARPAbet-style id list; the ids are content-facing strings, exact spelling is builder-mechanical.
